up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with pChEMBL values for the target CHEMBL1938222 (1-phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate 5-kinase). Include the assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Restrict to rows where the standard relation is '=' and pChEMBL is not null. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: WITH target_info AS ( SELECT tid, target_type, tax_id FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1938222' ), molecule_data AS ( SELECT md.molregno, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary md LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno ) SELECT DISTINCT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, ti.target_type, ti.tax_id, mdata.canonical_smiles, mdata.molecule_chembl_id, act.standard_type, act.pchembl_value FROM activities act JOIN assays ass ON act.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_info ti ON ass.tid = ti.tid JOIN molecule_data mdata ON act.molregno = mdata.molregno WHERE act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mdata.molecule_chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
